packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates: one grouped PR, merged automatically once the CI `checks` job passes
Majors: one PR each, reviewed by a person, never merged automatically
Node follows production: the newest major Vercel offers (pin-versions). Bump .nvmrc and engines deliberately.
@types/node matches the Node runtime major in .nvmrc
Blocked: typescript-eslint supports TypeScript <6.1; TypeScript 7 waits for 7.1's API and typescript-eslint support
Third-party GitHub Actions are pinned to a commit SHA; first-party actions/* keep major tags (pin-versions)
